title: Dividend Accounting Rule: Amount Placed on Deposit at a Whole Life Insurance Anniversary
content:
**Whole Life Insurance — accumulate option.**

**Rule.** The amount placed on deposit is the most recent dividend declared on the policy ledger, rounded half up to the cent.

The most recent declared dividend is the amount on the latest dividend declaration entry on the policy's activity history, by date.

| Dividend declaration entries on the ledger (hypothetical) | Amount placed on deposit |
|---|---|
| June 1, 2024: 1180.00; June 1, 2025: 1240.00 | 1240.00 |
| June 1, 2025: 987.65 | 987.65 |

**Question.** Is an earlier year's declaration ever the amount? No; the latest declaration by date is the amount placed on deposit.
